title: RENEW YOUR MIND
FIND GOD'S WILL
end: The Guided Path — seek God's wisdom for every step
stock_queries: soft morning light on alpine meadow
dusk in a silent mountain pass

scenes.a: That feeling that you are being pulled by every passing opinion is exhausting you today.
Hear the instruction of the Lord:
And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
Lord, help me step away from the noise of the world that distracts my focus.
I yield my understanding to You, trusting that Your perfect will is far better than my own.
Grant me the discernment to recognize the path You have prepared for my life tonight.
